summary: Behavior change: a picked mention is sent with its canonical label. Ordinary labels stay byte-identical; a label with { } <! -->, control or format characters, line breaks or over 120 code points is sent changed, and a mention with an invalid type or id is sent as @label without a marker.
howTo: Nothing to do for the new default. What changes: { } <! --> --!> become ｛ ｝ ‹! --› --!›; control, line and paragraph separators and whitespace runs become one space; format characters are removed (zero-width, bidi, tag characters, soft hyphen, also the ZWJ of emoji sequences and the ZWNJ of Persian words); NFC; over 120 code points the label is cut to 119 and …. A mention whose type is not [a-z][a-z0-9_.-]{0,63}, the entity type pattern (capitals, non-ASCII), or whose id has : { } < >, whitespace, control or format characters or more than 200 UTF-16 units gets no marker, its text is prefix and label. Stored older text is read as before. An app that needs the old format sets mentions: { serialize: { labels: 'raw' } } on the chat provider; maxLabelLength (1-120) cuts shorter. Own parsers and server code can use canonicalMentionLabel, parseMentionMarkers, serializeMentionMarker, isMentionMarkerType and isMentionMarkerId from glirastes/contracts. See docs/chat-interactions.md, Mention markers.
